subject: geography
title: Important Lakes of India
description: Major lakes with their locations and features

content.overview: India has numerous lakes, both natural and artificial, with ecological and economic significance.
keyPoints: Wular Lake (J&K): Largest freshwater lake in Asia, Ramsar site
Dal Lake (J&K): Famous for houseboats, Srinagar
Loktak Lake (Manipur): Only floating lake in world, phumdis
Chilika Lake (Odisha): Largest brackish water lake in Asia, Ramsar site
Vembanad Lake (Kerala): Longest lake in India, Ramsar site
Pulicat Lake (Andhra Pradesh/Tamil Nadu): Second largest brackish lake
Sambhar Salt Lake (Rajasthan): Largest inland salt lake
Bhimtal Lake (Uttarakhand): Largest lake in Kumaon region
Nainital Lake (Uttarakhand): Pear-shaped lake, tourist destination
Roopkund Lake (Uttarakhand): Skeleton lake, mystery lake
Gurudongmar Lake (Sikkim): Highest lake in India (17,800 ft)
Tso Moriri (Ladakh): High altitude lake, Ramsar site
Pangong Tso (Ladakh): Famous for color changes, 134 km long
Upper Ladakh Lakes: Tso Kar, Startsapuk Tso, Kyagar Tso
Bhojtal Lake (MP): Largest artificial lake in Asia
Kankaria Lake (Gujarat): Largest artificial lake in Gujarat
Hussain Sagar (Telangana): Heart-shaped lake, Buddha statue
Kolleru Lake (Andhra Pradesh): Freshwater lake, Ramsar site
Nagarjuna Sagar (Telangana): One of largest man-made lakes
Gobind Sagar (Himachal Pradesh): Reservoir of Bhakra Dam

mnemonics.trick: J&K: Wular, Dal, Pangong | Manipur: Loktak | Odisha: Chilika | Kerala: Vembanad | Rajasthan: Sambhar | Uttarakhand: Bhimtal, Nainital, Roopkund | Sikkim: Gurudongmar | Ladakh: Tso Moriri, Pangong | MP: Bhojtal | Gujarat: Kankaria | Telangana: Hussain Sagar, Nagarjuna Sagar | AP: Pulicat, Kolleru | HP: Gobind Sagar
mnemonics.explanation: Remember lakes by state for quick recall

quiz.question: Which is the largest freshwater lake in Asia?
quiz.explanation: Wular Lake (J&K) is the largest freshwater lake in Asia

quiz.question: Which is the only floating lake in the world?
quiz.explanation: Loktak Lake (Manipur) is the only floating lake in the world

quiz.question: Chilika Lake is located in:
quiz.explanation: Chilika Lake is located in Odisha
